tavily.text:
To set up and install loguru, the GitHub Actions workflow for Delgan/loguru uses a container image for unsupported Python versions and skips the setup-python step. For supported versions, it checks out the repository, sets up Python using actions/setup-python@v6 with the specified version, upgrades pip, installs tox, and runs tests using tox. The workflow supports multiple Python versions including 3.5 to 3.14 and pypy-3.11. The sources do not provide specific installation instructions beyond this workflow setup.
To install the loguru Python logging library from its GitHub repository, you can use pip to install it directly. The sources indicate that the project's documentation can be found at https://loguru.readthedocs.io/en/stable/index.html. The pyproject.toml file specifies dependencies and build configurations, including the requirement for flit_core version 3 to 5. The GitHub Actions workflow file shows that the project supports multiple Python versions, from 3.5 to 3.14, and PyPy 3.11. The sources do not provide a definitive answer to the specific installation command but suggest using pip for installation.
To install the loguru library in Python, use the command `pip install loguru`. The sources indicate that Python version 3.10 or higher is required for packages that depend on loguru, such as beans-logging. The primary source for loguru is available at https://github.com/Delgan/loguru. The sources do not provide a definitive answer to specific installation requirements beyond the Python version.
